cues: Synthetic auxins, I B A and N A A, root cuttings.
Auxin can set seedless, parthenocarpic fruit and stop fruit dropping early.
And the synthetic auxin two four D kills broad-leaved dicot weeds in a rice or wheat field while sparing the crop.
One caution: the dose that makes a stem grow fastest stops a root, because roots are far more sensitive.
